DEFINE INSTRUMENT tof_imaging_beamline (
lam = 3.5, // AA] Mean wavelength
dlam = 1.3, // AA] Wavelength spread
ap_D = 0.016 // m] Aperture diameter
)

DECLARE 
%{
%}

INITIALIZE 
%{
// Start of initialize for generated tof_imaging_beamline
%}

TRACE 
COMPONENT src = Source_simple(
 yheight = 0.12, xwidth = 0.1,
 dist = 1, focus_xw = ap_D,
 focus_yh = ap_D, lambda0 = lam,
 dlambda = dlam, flux = 10000000000000)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT aperture = Slit(
 radius = 0.5*ap_D)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 1.0) RELATIVE src

COMPONENT scraper = Slit(
 xwidth = 0.3, yheight = 0.3)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 10.0) RELATIVE src

COMPONENT fov_mon = PSD_monitor(
 nx = 128, ny = 128,
 filename = "fov.dat", xwidth = 0.28,
 yheight = 0.28, restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 20.0) RELATIVE src

COMPONENT det = PSD_monitor(
 nx = 256, ny = 256,
 filename = "det.dat", xwidth = 0.2,
 yheight = 0.2, restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 25.0) RELATIVE src

COMPONENT det_lam = L_monitor(
 nL = 200, filename = "det_lam.dat",
 xwidth = 0.2, yheight = 0.2,
 Lmin = lam-2*dlam, Lmax = lam+2*dlam,
 restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 25.01) RELATIVE src

FINALLY 
%{
// Start of finally for generated tof_imaging_beamline
%}

END

### Instrument Structure & Parameters
- **Parameters**: `lam = 3.5 Å`, `dlam = 1.3 Å`, `ap_D = 0.016 m`
- **Components**:
  1. `src` (`Source_simple`): Rectangular source emitting at $\lambda = 3.5 \pm 1.3\text{ Å}$ focused onto a target area defined by `ap_D` at $z = 1.0\text{ m}$.
  2. `aperture` (`Slit`): Circular aperture with radius $0.5 \times \text{ap\_D} = 0.008\text{ m}$ at $z = 1.0\text{ m}$.
  3. `scraper` (`Slit`): Rectangular aperture ($0.3\text{ m} \times 0.3\text{ m}$) at $z = 10.0\text{ m}$.
  4. `fov_mon` (`PSD_monitor`): 2D field-of-view monitor ($0.28\text{ m} \times 0.28\text{ m}$, $128 \times 128$ pixels) at $z = 20.0\text{ m}$.
  5. `det` (`PSD_monitor`): 2D detector ($0.20\text{ m} \times 0.20\text{ m}$, $256 \times 256$ pixels) at $z = 25.0\text{ m}$.
  6. `det_lam` (`L_monitor`): Wavelength spectrum monitor ($0.20\text{ m} \times 0.20\text{ m}$, 200 bins, $0.9\text{ Å} \le \lambda \le 6.1\text{ Å}$) at $z = 25.01\text{ m}$.
